race.comment: PASS THE PEAK (3) is worth following up off a freshen after disappointing as favourite last time. His two runs to kick off the prep were much better and dropping back to trip should suit. ROCKRATA (14) arrives in winning form after scoring comfortably at Gatton as a well-supported favourite, and his nose defeat at this venue adds depth. WAVERLEY (4) has had little luck at both runs this campaign and he is better suited rising to a distance where he's already won. AZUKI (1) couldn't bring up the hat-trick last time but is in good touch and remains firmly in the mix.
